channel.title: Times of San Diego - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Times of San Diego (timesofsandiego.com)

item.title: The Trump administration dismisses the endangered species list as ‘Hotel California.’ But there’s far more to the story
item.description: The strict regulations of the Endangered Species Act inhibit development and “energy domination,” the Trump administration claims.

item.title: Opinion: America’s MAHA nutrition rules are coming — the science might not
item.description: The swift departure from established science is a common theme from MAHA and is likely to be manifest in America's new nutritional guidelines.

item.title: Notre Dame dethrones defending champs JSerra to win Holiday Classic
item.description: Notre Dame, from Sherman Oaks, California, won the prestigious National Division of this year's Holiday Classic.

item.title: Motorists warned of delays on I-5 near San Ysidro
item.description: Motorists heading south on Interstate 5 near the San Ysidro Land Port of Entry will experience significant traffic delays as a $2.7 million construction project begins.

item.title: Holiday Bowl attendees urged to use Green Line Trolley to avoid crowds
item.description: Attendees of Friday evening's 5 p.m. Holiday Bowl urged to take the MTS' Green Line Trolley to Snapdragon Stadium Station to avoid crowds.

item.title: Downed tree knocks out power to hundreds in Poway
item.description: The outage was reported at 5:33 a.m. when the tree came into contact with the utility's system, according to San Diego Gas & Electric.

item.title: 5 big housing development fights to watch in 2026
item.description: Major regional redevelopments, the school district's big foray into homebuilding and a Golden Hill case that could set a precedent will dominate housing politics in 2026.

item.title: Police chase in Pacific Beach ends on I-15 after suspect stopped with spike strip
item.description: The Aero Drive off-ramp was temporarily closed following the chase, causing heavy traffic, police said.

item.title: Open carry ‘part of nation’s history,’ judge writes in declaring California ban unconstitutional
item.description: Writing for the majority, Circuit Judge Lawrence VanDyke, a Trump appointee, said California's open carry law cannot stand under a U.S. Supreme Court 2022 decision.

item.title: SMU beats Arizona 24-19, easing pain of wild, long-ago Holiday Bowl loss
item.description: SMU quarterback Kevin Jennings completed 21 of 32 passes, highlighted by one for 80 yards on a razzle-dazzle play to start the Holiday Bowl.
